primary_work.title: The Mechanistic Emergence of Symbol Grounding in Language Models

decision: NARROWED BEYOND MECHANISTIC EMERGENCE OF SYMBOL GROUNDING — NOT ADOPTED
prior_art_boundary: environment-conditioned linguistic prediction can emerge under causal language modeling
middle-layer and aggregate-head mechanisms can mediate grounding-like prediction
activation intervention can establish causal contribution of internal components
mechanistic grounding evidence does not imply unique denotation or joint partition identification
counterexample: A simultaneous relabeling of environmental target blocks, raw-utterance classes, internal aggregate coordinates, language tokens, decoder, and denotation preserves corpus likelihood, grounding scores, causal activation-intervention effects, and task behavior while changing raw-language equivalence and semantic target alignment.
official_code_status: primary paper and supplementary record verified; paper-specific immutable official-code reproduction package not verified
